description: Searches Glazecalc's plain-language guides for potters (glazing from first principles, making a glaze, safe mixing, safety at home with children and pets, firing a kiln, and a companion to John Britt's free glaze course, in English only) in the language asked for, or in English where that language has no match. Returns each matching section's title, anchor, a short excerpt, its address on the website and its resource URI, which resources/read returns in full. Use it for glaze defects, safety, firing and terms, and cite the address.

cones.description: How the potter fires, for the parts of the guides that differ: Orton cones (the default), SK cones (JIS R 8101) or by temperature.

language.description: The language for any sentences in the answer, as a BCP 47 tag such as "en", "de" or "ja". Languages Glazecalc does not offer are answered in English.

limit.description: At most this many sections (5 unless asked).

query.description: Words to look for, such as "crawling", "respirator", "bisque schedule" or "specific gravity".

name: search_guides
title: Search the guides
